mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 55% of observations when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low and unemployment is rising, the market anticipates a recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) shows no significant negative correlation with 60-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), the S&P 500 tends to rebound as the Fed implements stimulus, producing positive forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 55% of observations when UNRATE > 5.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 55% of periods when HOUST > 1100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1000 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 55% of instances when HOUST < 1000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are rising and industrial production (INDPRO) is falling, it indicates a demand-supply mismatch that triggers negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) shows no significant negative correlation with 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 typically rallies as the Fed responds with stimulus, producing positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 55% of observations when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).
